reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Tennessee
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Are the primary methods of service permitted for an eviction action specified?"
    We treat "specified" as: the relevant eviction statute(s) explicitly enumerate one or more
    permissible methods of service of summons/warrant in commencing the action.
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

scenario_state(tennessee).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question concerns an eviction (forcible entry and detainer / unlawful detainer)
% action under the chapter addressed by TN Code  29-18-115.
scenario_action(eviction_action_commenced_under_tn_ch29_18).

% Typical eviction actions seek possession; the statute itself distinguishes possession
% vs. monetary judgment for a particular alternative service method.
scenario_relief_sought(possession_of_real_property).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario (as encoded) holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(tennessee),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction_action_commenced_under_tn_ch29_18),
    scenario_relief_sought(possession_of_real_property).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translation: TN Code  29-18-115 (2021)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  We encode the methods of service explicitly permitted by TN Code  29-18-115 (2021).
  These are "methods of service" that are "good and sufficient to enable the landlord
  to regain possession" and/or otherwise authorized in commencing the action.
*/

% TN Code  29-18-115(a): service on any adult person found in possession/occupying.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(adult_person_in_possession).

% TN Code  29-18-115(a)(1)-(2): when adult-in-possession cannot be served and personal
% service is dispensed with in listed cases; proceeding governed by publication statutes,
% plus posting publication notice on front door/front portion at least 15 days prior.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(publication_notice_plus_posting_15_days).

% TN Code  29-18-115(b): service on a contractually named party.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(contractually_named_party).

% TN Code  29-18-115(c): service by certified return receipt mail via sheriff/constable
% after plaintiff/attorney/agent lodges process; includes requirements for completion.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(certified_mail_via_sheriff_or_constable).

% TN Code  29-18-115(e)(1): personal service by sheriff/deputy/constable/private process server
% on any one named defendant with contractual or possessory right.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(personal_service_on_named_defendant_by_authorized_server).

% TN Code  29-18-115(e)(2): after 3 attempts on different dates and documentation,
% service for possession may be by: posting on door + first class mail + entry on warrant,
% at least 6 days before appearance date. Applies only to possession, not money judgment.
statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(posting_plus_first_class_mail_after_three_attempts_possession_only).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* A method is specified/permitted for this scenario's jurisdiction and year if it appears
   in the statute set for TN 2021 and the scenario is the covered kind of action. */
legal_permitted_service_method_for_scenario(Method) :-
    scenario_statement,
    statute_tn_29_18_115_2021_permitted_service_method(Method).

/* The question asks whether the (primary) methods are specified.
   We answer "yes" if at least one permitted service method is specified by statute. */
legal_primary_methods_of_service_specified_for_eviction :-
    legal_permitted_service_method_for_scenario(_AnyMethod),
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_primary_methods_of_service_specified_for_eviction,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are the primary methods of service permitted for an eviction action specified?
